Noctua has put a lot of engineering into its Thermosiphon and Noctua AIO over the past year of development, with the AIO now imminently launching (and which we will review soon). We talk about Noctua's AIO engineering for acoustic design and vibration mitigation, include scientific discussion and educational information on how the thermosiphon is being designed to cope with vaporization and vapor film challenges, and more. Jakob Dellinger joins us once again from Noctua's technical team to explain the developments.

Watch our video from last year describing the acoustic damping properties in more depth: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UpNmd3Y9qUU

AMD's Lisa Su also gave a commencement speech featuring AI, where she got booed, and seemed to almost become self-aware while rhetorically questioning whether we should actually be dumping this much money into something that is probably a bubble.
